workflow_plan.objective: Generate prompts and code, run section-wise extraction tests, and repair prompt/code/workflow based on measured extraction quality.

section_test_plan.purpose: First pass for fabrication/processing: extract method, route, sample geometry, and process sequence.
Second pass for fabrication/processing: extract temperature, time, pressure, atmosphere, environment, treatment, and other condition details using the method pass as context.
Classify figures before section4/section5 extraction to reduce curve/mechanism ownership errors.
Normalize scientific Unicode, LaTeX fragments, formula subscripts/superscripts, DOI punctuation, and selected schema fields after raw extraction.
repair_notes: Inserted because evaluator detected Unicode/formula normalization candidates.

dynamic_workflow_repairs.trigger: section2 method and condition extraction are misaligned after the default two-pass workflow
implementation: strengthen method_pass to preserve process sequence and sample geometry
strengthen conditions_pass to bind temperature/time/pressure/atmosphere to the correct method step

dynamic_workflow_repairs.trigger: section4 curves and section5 mechanism/theory evidence are confused
implementation: classify every figure/panel by evidence type and allowed section
route curve figures to material_info.section4 and theory/simulation/mechanism figures to section5 or section3 as defined by Step8

strategies.name: classification_gate
strategies.use_when: The corpus may include review, non-experimental, non-target, or multi-material papers.
strategies.strategy: Gate papers before expensive section extraction; route single-material and multi-material papers differently.

strategies.name: section5_and_resources_early
strategies.use_when: Theory/mechanism and paper-level resources are useful global context for later extraction.
strategies.strategy: Extract section5 and paper resources before section-specific value extraction.

strategies.name: figure_classification_before_s4_s5
strategies.use_when: Figure-heavy sections may confuse property curves with theory, mechanism, or characterization evidence.
strategies.strategy: Classify figures/tables/panels first; route section4 curves and section5/theory evidence using the classification result.

strategies.name: section2_two_pass
strategies.use_when: Fabrication, processing, treatment, or measurement-preparation fields combine method identity, process sequence, and detailed conditions.
strategies.strategy: First extract coarse section2 method/process information; then run a second fine pass for method-specific conditions and mapping.

strategies.name: section3_section4_pair
strategies.use_when: Characterization evidence and macroscopic curves need coordinated figure ownership.
strategies.strategy: Extract section3 and section4 as separate sections while sharing figure classification context.

strategies.name: json_check_and_schema_cleanup
strategies.use_when: Raw extraction JSON contains invalid structure, section drift, or section2 method naming inconsistency.
strategies.strategy: Run JSON repair, schema cleanup, section2 merge, and method mapping before final normalization.

strategies.name: unicode_semantic_normalization
strategies.use_when: Extracted strings contain Unicode variants, mojibake, inconsistent symbols, or semantically equivalent wording.
strategies.strategy: Normalize strings with schema-aware prompts after section JSON is structurally valid.

strategies.name: final_merge
strategies.use_when: All section outputs are available and normalized.
strategies.strategy: Merge section outputs into one final JSON with primary_signature, material_info, section5, and paper_info.

strategies.name: multi_material_manifest_fact_match
strategies.use_when: A paper contains multiple candidate material targets or the single-material gate is uncertain.
strategies.strategy: Use manifest -> fact_candidates -> matcher -> aggregate instead of forcing all facts into one material record.

integration_policy: Use these as workflow and prompt/code design references, not as a mandatory hardcoded flow.
The initial generated workflow should still be section-wise and schema-driven.

During optimization, the supervisor may adopt reference strategies such as two-pass section2 extraction, figure classification before section4/section5, JSON repair, semantic normalization, voting, or multi-material manifest/fact/matcher aggregation.

repair_policy: Run extraction section by section using workflow_plan.execution_order.
Treat dependency outputs as context, not as fields to overwrite.
If a field is missing, emit missing_reason instead of inventing values.
If section4/section5 figure ownership is ambiguous, use figure_classification before extraction.
If section2 method and condition details are misaligned, use method_pass then conditions_pass.
If JSON output is truncated or invalid, reduce per-call field scope or split the stage into smaller extraction batches before retrying.
If extracted values are mostly null, narrow the prompt to only evidence-backed fields and require missing_reason outside extracted_fields.
If evaluation reports unicode_normalization_required, insert or preserve an explicit unicode_normalization postprocess stage; do not hide this behavior inside extraction prompts.

strategies.name: classification_gate
strategies.use_when: The corpus may include review, non-experimental, non-target, or multi-material papers.
strategies.strategy: Gate papers before expensive section extraction; route single-material and multi-material papers differently.

strategies.name: section5_and_resources_early
strategies.use_when: Theory/mechanism and paper-level resources are useful global context for later extraction.
strategies.strategy: Extract section5 and paper resources before section-specific value extraction.

strategies.name: figure_classification_before_s4_s5
strategies.use_when: Figure-heavy sections may confuse property curves with theory, mechanism, or characterization evidence.
strategies.strategy: Classify figures/tables/panels first; route section4 curves and section5/theory evidence using the classification result.

strategies.name: section2_two_pass
strategies.use_when: Fabrication, processing, treatment, or measurement-preparation fields combine method identity, process sequence, and detailed conditions.
strategies.strategy: First extract coarse section2 method/process information; then run a second fine pass for method-specific conditions and mapping.

strategies.name: section3_section4_pair
strategies.use_when: Characterization evidence and macroscopic curves need coordinated figure ownership.
strategies.strategy: Extract section3 and section4 as separate sections while sharing figure classification context.

strategies.name: json_check_and_schema_cleanup
strategies.use_when: Raw extraction JSON contains invalid structure, section drift, or section2 method naming inconsistency.
strategies.strategy: Run JSON repair, schema cleanup, section2 merge, and method mapping before final normalization.

strategies.name: unicode_semantic_normalization
strategies.use_when: Extracted strings contain Unicode variants, mojibake, inconsistent symbols, or semantically equivalent wording.
strategies.strategy: Normalize strings with schema-aware prompts after section JSON is structurally valid.

strategies.name: final_merge
strategies.use_when: All section outputs are available and normalized.
strategies.strategy: Merge section outputs into one final JSON with primary_signature, material_info, section5, and paper_info.

strategies.name: multi_material_manifest_fact_match
strategies.use_when: A paper contains multiple candidate material targets or the single-material gate is uncertain.
strategies.strategy: Use manifest -> fact_candidates -> matcher -> aggregate instead of forcing all facts into one material record.

integration_policy: Use these as workflow and prompt/code design references, not as a mandatory hardcoded flow.
The initial generated workflow should still be section-wise and schema-driven.
